# Wold Architects & Engineers

> A full-service architecture and engineering firm specializing in education, healthcare, and government sector design with integrated planning and sustainable solutions.

Wold Architects & Engineers is a multi-office firm with locations in Minneapolis, Denver, Palatine, and Brentwood, offering comprehensive architectural design, engineering, interior design, and master planning services. The firm demonstrates deep expertise in K-12 education facilities, healthcare campus design, and public sector infrastructure projects.

## Key Topics

- Architectural Design Services
- Education Design
- Healthcare Architecture
- Government Architecture
- Engineering Services
- Sustainable Design
- Interior Design
- Facilities Master Planning
- Integrated Design Process
- Community Engagement
- Energy Modeling
- 21st Century Learning
- Acute Care Design
- Senior Living
- Minneapolis, Denver, Palatine, Brentwood

## Core Services & Expertise

- [Full Service Architecture Firm](https://www.woldae.com/full-service-architecture-firm): Full-service architecture firm offering design, engineering, and planning services
- [Architectural Design Services](https://www.woldae.com/services/architectural-design-services): Architectural design services integrating client relationships with innovative solutions
- [Engineering](https://www.woldae.com/services/engineering): In-house engineering services including civil, electrical, mechanical, structural
- [Architectural and Interior Design](https://www.woldae.com/services/architectural-and-interior-design-services): Architectural and interior design services emphasizing user experience and space planning
- [Facilities Master Plan](https://www.woldae.com/services/facilities-master-plan): Facilities master planning with stakeholder engagement and capacity analysis
- [Sustainable Design](https://www.woldae.com/services/sustainable-design): Sustainable design solutions with energy modeling and daylight analysis
